purpose: Analyst-assigned deterministic roots for the SD-5 development probe on the disclosed 2026-09-28 corpus (development data only). Assigned from the task prompt by contract domain before any probe run; not custodian keys.
default_rationale: run, analyze, evaluate, results/report review, gate evidence, code change, report writing or delegation (7.1 software-implementation description)

excluded.rationale: selection negatives belong to the ordinary stratum (contract §1 item 12); a delivered-treatment probe does not measure them

scientific-formulation.rationale: D1: author or review a formulation, judge fitness of a model for a new scientific use, or whether accepted formulation assumptions hold

numerical-algorithm-design.rationale: D2: author, review or judge the soundness of the accepted calibration method

software-design.rationale: D3: author or review a software design document

software-documentation.rationale: documentation-only edits (links, units/links in a report, changelog)
